# DPA-SDT full reference

## Overview
Document partnership agreements, connect self-declarations, and track ERC-721 participation packages.
DPA-SDT is a private source repository for a crypto-wallet partnership workspace and research prototype.
Draft and review off-chain terms locally, record individual acceptance, and inspect participation packages.
Author: Maxim Osovsky — https://www.linkedin.com/in/osovsky/
Repository: https://github.com/maximosovsky/DPA-SDT
Root README.md and these root discovery files describe the current local workflow.

## Publication boundary
This is an independent source snapshot, not a GitHub fork or a new blockchain execution.
Source/UI names, domain separators, attribution, and historical URLs are retained.
Public website: https://maximosovsky.github.io/Decentralized-Partnership-Agreements-DPA-Self-Declared-Tokens-SDT/
The public website is compiled output maintained in a separate repository.
Source-era Vercel test deployment: https://cryptopassport-testnet.vercel.app/
This private checkout does not automatically publish either host or alter hosting settings.
README preview docs/preview.png was captured from this checkout's production build without a connected wallet.

## Features
Agreement workspace: draft exact terms and ordered allocations locally, export evidence, review invitations.
DPA: immutable agreement/version/allocation commitments and individual EOA EIP-712 acceptance.
Signature context binds chain, contract, wallet, SDT, token, identity commitment, terms, allocation, and nonce.
SDT: reusable self-declared identity basis; no independently verified identity or unique-person certificate.
Exclusive package route: claim ERC-721 participation packages only after complete acceptance.
Splitting burns parent packages, retains history, and conserves allocated quantity.
Package experiments include sale, pledge, and funded test-ETH loans.
Separate read-only verifier compares original declaration strings with historical acceptance snapshots.
It checks supported canonical contracts, records, events, receipts, and EIP-712 context through RPC.
It exports technical JSON/HTML reports without connecting a wallet.
Pre-authenticated identification and contract-wallet acceptance are not implemented.

## Thirteen-field SDT v2 commitment
Algorithm: SHA-256.
Domain separator: cryptopassport:SDT:identity:v2 followed by a null byte.
Ordered fields: fullName, dateOfBirth, passportNumber, bankTransactionId, bankName, bankBic, bankAccountNumber, bankDate, bankTime, bankTimezone, bankAmount, bankCurrency, bankRecipient.
Serialization: UTF-8 domain; uint32 big-endian field count; then uint32 big-endian byte lengths and exact UTF-8 bytes for each ordered field name and value.
No trimming, case folding, Unicode normalization, or silent date/amount/time conversion.
The helper validates required fields, nonempty valid strings, and the DD.MM.YYYY birth date.
Existing domain and evidence schema identifiers are preserved intentionally.

## Safety and scope
Creation and transaction experiments use fictional fixtures and test ETH only.
The separate read-only verifier can accept the thirteen original field strings, not only creation fixtures.
Field strings are hashed locally and are not included in RPC queries.
Reports omit the strings by default; opting in creates a sensitive downloaded copy.
Clear removes in-memory inputs/reports, not previously downloaded files.
Public unsalted hashes are guessable and are not encryption.
Hash correspondence does not authenticate a person, bank record, or enforceable right.
On-chain hashes cannot recover missing agreement documents; retain exact off-chain bytes.
A matching acceptance snapshot does not by itself identify the hashing scheme.
RPC failure or inconsistent/unknown contracts must not produce a positive conclusion.
Base Sepolia observations are not proof of Ethereum L1 finality.
No legal certification, court-admissibility guarantee, or production/mainnet readiness is claimed.
Never commit credentials, original identity/bank inputs, sensitive reports, or signed raw transactions.
Do not use publicly known local development accounts on public networks.
Public-network deployment and transaction runners require separate authorization.

## Architecture
| Path | Role |
| --- | --- |
| test-deployment/client/ | Browser application entry points and styles |
| test-deployment/src/ | Hashing, agreement documents, evidence, state and provenance helpers |
| test-deployment/contracts/ | Solidity implementations |
| test-deployment/*.html | Workspace, formation, participation, packages, sale, verifier and legal routes |
| test-deployment/test/ | node:test / Hardhat / Chromium regressions |
| test-deployment/scripts/ | Local checks and retained research runners |
| test-deployment/canonical-artifacts/ | Six exact deployed artifacts pinned by SHA-256 |
| test-deployment/docs/ | Specifications, threat model, test matrix and historical evidence |
| docs/preview.png | Current local production-build preview |
| PROVENANCE.md, snapshot-manifest.json | Original copied snapshot provenance, not later documentation hashes |
| VERIFICATION.md | Preserved historical verification record |

## Dependencies and networks
Node.js >=22.13 and npm; current checks used Node.js 26.7.0 and npm 11.19.0.
TypeScript 5.9.3; Vite 7.3.7; viem 2.57.6.
Solidity 0.8.28; OpenZeppelin Contracts 5.4.0; Hardhat 3.19.0.
Playwright 1.64.1 with Chromium.
Base Sepolia chain ID 84532; ephemeral local Hardhat chain ID 31337.
The read-only verifier allows local chain 31337 only on localhost/127.0.0.1.
No wallet key, RPC credential, environment variables, or backend is needed for the static build.

## Local workflow
Authenticated clone: git clone https://github.com/maximosovsky/DPA-SDT.git
Working directory: cd DPA-SDT/test-deployment
Install: npm ci
Browser prerequisite: npx playwright install chromium
Prepare compiled artifacts: npm run build
Development server: npm run dev -- --port 4173 --strictPort
Local UI: http://127.0.0.1:4173/
Use another free port if 4173 is occupied; do not stop an unrelated listener.
Full suite: npm test
Hash helper suite: npm run test:hash
Production build: npm run build
Standalone compilation: npm run compile
npm test invokes pretest, which builds its fixtures automatically.
npm run build compiles all imported contracts, checks/installs six pinned artifacts, then runs vite build.
Build output: test-deployment/dist/.

## Current local verification
npm ci completed; npm audit reported zero vulnerabilities at that run.
Chromium installation completed.
npm test: 234 passing / 0 failing, including Chromium checks.
npm run test:hash: 4 passing / 0 failing, no skipped tests.
npm run build succeeded.
Hardhat reported a pre-existing hre.network.connect() deprecation warning.
These checks are local, not a rerun of historical public-network scenarios.
VERIFICATION.md retains older verification outcomes and is not rewritten by this README update.

Recorded provider: controlled Playwright EIP-1193 test-wallet adapter, not manual MetaMask.
Raw evidence includes failed/probe entries; final manifest describes reconciliation.
